name: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage

evidence.files: C02: hosted S3-compatible object storage is the primary role; F05: S3 API compatibility

line: S3-compatible object storage for files, media and backups.

free.text: Up to 1 TB/30-day trial (limits vary); expiry deletes trial account and data

cells.metered: $7.99/TB-mo; 1 TB min; 90-day object min; API free
cells.regions: North America, EMEA and APAC locations

sql.math: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage is not a database service.
Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage is not a database service.

files.math: 100 GB is billed as the 1 TB minimum, which costs $7.99. Objects have a 90-day minimum, so early deletes are still billed. This assumes 100 GB of egress fits the active-storage policy. API requests are free.

jobs.math: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage does not run application jobs.
